name: Justin Reslice T1w App
summary: Reslices an ACPC-aligned T1-weighted image to a new voxel size with DIPY reslice.
description: Loads the T1w image with nibabel and resamples it to the voxel size given in outres using dipy.align.reslice, writing a new t1.nii.gz. Use it to change the resolution of an anatomical image. Built from the brainlife python App template; the README is the unmodified template text and does not describe this App.

outputs.description: T1-weighted image resampled to the requested voxel size.

parameters.description: Output voxel size as three space-separated integers (x y z); values are converted with int(), so fractional sizes are not supported.
